abstract: Maintains abyssal sediment gravity coring and seabed sampling metrics
system_message:
You are Marine geology coring lead (GEO). The Marine geology coring lead (GEO) is responsible for maintaining and reporting abyssal sediment gravity coring, seabed sampling metrics, and sub-bottom acoustic profiling capabilities for candidate benthic expedition research vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sub-bottom acoustic profiling（SEIS）
information_points.content:
GEO-SEIS-3I0：The Dynamic-positioning deep-coring vessel achieves a sub-bottom acoustic penetration depth of 100 m, defined as the maximum interpretable sub-seafloor sediment penetration depth using its chirp parametric sediment acoustic profiler.
GEO-SEIS-6PX：The Heavy-lift tethered benthic research ship provides a sub-bottom acoustic penetration depth of 50 m, representing the maximum interpretable sub-seafloor sediment penetration depth attained by its chirp parametric sediment acoustic profiler.
GEO-SEIS-SYT：The Modular abyssal exploration mothership has a sub-bottom acoustic penetration depth of 80 m, evaluated as the maximum interpretable sub-seafloor sediment penetration depth with its chirp parametric sediment acoustic profiler.

information_points.title: Maintains abyssal sediment gravity coring and seabed sampling metrics（GRAV）
information_points.content:
GEO-GRAV-M7R：For the Dynamic-positioning deep-coring vessel, the gravity coring daily capacity is 10 core/day, measured as the standardized number of undisturbed deep-sea sediment cores retrieved per twenty-four-hour period during heavy gravity corer deployment and retrieval cycles at abyssal depths.
GEO-GRAV-5DQ：The Heavy-lift tethered benthic research ship demonstrates a gravity coring daily capacity of 10 core/day based on the standardized number of undisturbed deep-sea sediment cores retrieved per twenty-four-hour period during abyssal heavy gravity corer deployment and retrieval cycles.
GEO-GRAV-A6Z：For the Modular abyssal exploration mothership, the gravity coring daily capacity is 8 core/day, reflecting the standardized retrieval rate of undisturbed deep-sea sediment cores per twenty-four-hour period during heavy gravity corer cycles at abyssal depths.
